name: Quote of the day (portrait)
description: A typography-led quote screen: a big serif quotation, who said it and where, with a live date in your language. For a lobby, staff room, school corridor or the screen by the coffee machine. Portrait 9:16 layout.
author: ScreenTinker

params.name: eyebrow
params.label: Small heading
params.help: A short label above the quote. Capitals read best.

params.name: quote
params.label: Quote
params.help: Without quotation marks: the big mark is drawn for you. Up to about 130 characters.
params.default: It is not that we have a short time to live, but that we waste a lot of it.

params.name: attribution_detail
params.label: Source or role
params.help: A book, a role or a year. Leave empty to hide.
params.default: On the Shortness of Life, c. 49 AD

params.name: show_date
params.label: Show today's date
params.help: The screen's live date, in the language and timezone below.

params.name: timezone
params.label: Date timezone
params.help: Which timezone "today" is in. Leave empty to use the screen's own clock.

params.name: locale
params.label: Language
params.help: The language of the date, e.g. en-GB, de-DE or fr-CA. Leave empty for the screen's language.

params.name: show_logo
params.label: Show the logo
params.help: Off hides the logo and its space stays empty.

params.name: logo
params.label: Logo
params.help: A PNG or SVG with a transparent background, in a light colour for the default dark background.

params.name: accent
params.label: Accent colour
params.help: The big quotation mark, small heading, rule and decoration.
